Assistant Professor - Research & Extension

The Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics at North Carolina State University invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor position in agricultural economics with responsibilities in research (50%) and Extension (50%).

Responsibilities include establishing and maintaining an innovative, integrated research and Extension program in food-animal economics that addresses important economic issues facing North Carolina’s animal agriculture industries and supports the goals of the North Carolina Food Animal Initiative. Relevant areas may include production economics; contracting, vertical integration and coordination; industry structure and supply chains; animal health and biosecurity; technology adoption and innovation; consumer and food markets; and policy issues affecting the profitability and competitiveness of animal agriculture. The successful candidate will conduct high-quality research leading to publications in peer-reviewed journals; develop and deliver research-based Extension programming that provides decision-relevant economic information for North Carolina producers, agribusinesses, industry organizations, policymakers, and other stakeholders; supervise graduate students; secure external funding; and provide service to the department, college, university, and profession. 

This position requires a Ph.D. in agricultural economics, economics, or a closely related discipline, strong research potential, and excellent written and oral communication skills.

For full position description and to apply: https://jobs.ncsu.edu/postings/236909

For full consideration, please submit your application by December 1, 2026; applications will be accepted until the position is filled. For further information, contact Professor Nicholas Piggott, Chair of the Search Committee, at nick@ncsu.edu.
